command:
set -euo pipefail
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --target climate_io_adapter_tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^climate_io_adapter_tests$' --output-on-failure
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp README.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/CHANGELOG.md docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md docs/MVP_HARDWARE_SENSOR_SET.md docs/INTEGRATION_CONVERGENCE.md docs/PORTING_TO_LITEGRAPH.md AGENTS.md
grep -F 'ClimateInputAdapter' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
grep -F 'ClimateActuatorAdapter' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
grep -F 'ESP-IDF 5.5.4' README.md
git diff --check
